clue.text: Drink sealing complete mockery

indicators.note: sealing means closing something up inside, so the drink wraps around the other piece

parts.note: to sup is to drink
to end something is to complete it

explanation.surface: A drinker downs a glass while being thoroughly ridiculed.
explanation.definitionFit: A send-up is a parody or piece of ridicule, so it equals mockery as a noun.

clue.text: For this restaurant you need vehicle — absolutely!

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
very can mean absolutely, as in 'the very thing'

explanation.surface: Someone insists you must drive to reach a particular eatery.
explanation.definitionFit: A carvery is a restaurant serving roast meat carved to order, a buffet-style British eatery.

clue.text: Fat raider abandoned principle of decent business deals

indicators.note: abandoned suggests wild, unrestrained behaviour, so these letters run loose into a new order

explanation.surface: An overweight pirate has given up the ethics of honest commerce.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair trade is the movement for paying producers fair prices, an ethical trading principle.

clue.text: Material to consume — and rise after consumption!

parts.note: rep is a ribbed fabric, so a material
to eat is to consume

explanation.surface: Cloth to be eaten, followed by indigestion coming back up.
explanation.definitionFit: Food is said to repeat when its taste comes back up after a meal, a burp-like rising.

clue.text: Poet in hospital, wise person left abandoned

indicators.note: abandoned means given up, so the letter for left is dropped from the wise person

parts.note: an oracle is a source of wise counsel

explanation.surface: A poet lies in a ward, deserted by a sage friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Horace was the Roman lyric poet of the Odes, a classical writer of verse.

clue.text: Island's little house with female singer belting number

indicators.note: belting means wrapping a belt round, so the first pieces enclose the number

parts.note: HO is the short form of house
Lulu is a Scottish pop singer

explanation.surface: A small cottage on a tropical island houses a woman belting out a song.
explanation.walkthrough: Lulu is a Scottish pop singer famous for 'Shout'; the clue's 's stands for is.
explanation.definitionFit: Honolulu is on Oahu and serves as the capital of Hawaii, so it names an island setting.

clue.text: Investigation of sports field north of church

indicators.note: in a down clue, north of puts the first piece above, so before, the second

parts.note: rec is short for recreation ground
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Inquiries are made into a playing field lying just above a church.
explanation.walkthrough: A rec, or recreation ground, is a British public sports field.
explanation.definitionFit: A recce is a reconnaissance, a scouting survey or exploratory investigation.

clue.text: Note a perverse notion

definitions.meaning: a quarter note in music, worth one beat
a whim or odd fixed idea

explanation.definitionFit: Crotchet is both a musical note of one beat and an old word for a peculiar whim.

clue.text: Virile Cockney, an old-fashioned rocker, came forth

indicators.note: a Cockney speaker drops initial aitches, so the letter H goes

parts.note: a he-man is a virile type
an is the indefinite article, here giving the single letter
a Ted, or Teddy boy, was a 1950s rock-and-roll fan

explanation.surface: A macho Londoner and a retro rock fan emerged together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cockney' drops the H of HE-MAN, giving EMAN. A Teddy boy was a 1950s British youth in Edwardian-style dress.
explanation.definitionFit: To emanate is to issue or flow out, so the past tense means came forth.

clue.text: Grow old — a potential problem for rugger players

definitions.text: a potential problem for rugger players
definitions.meaning: in rugby, fumbling the ball forward is an infringement

explanation.definitionFit: Knock on is slang for getting older and also a rugby offence of dropping the ball forwards.

clue.text: Grebe maybe wanting day on water, heading off

indicators.note: heading off means the head, or first letter, of the water word is removed

parts.note: a river is a body of water

explanation.surface: A grebe goes without a day on the river, swimming away.
explanation.definitionFit: A grebe is a diving waterbird, so it is an example of the bird type.

clue.text: A criminal catching disease — it comes with having money

indicators.note: catching means holding something within, so the criminal surrounds the disease

parts.note: a fence is a criminal who handles stolen goods
flu is a common disease

explanation.surface: A crook comes down with an illness, a common side effect of wealth.
explanation.definitionFit: Affluence is wealth or prosperity, the state of being rich.

clue.text: Consider inadequate the amount professional's paid

indicators.note: inadequate means falling short, so the word loses its final letter

parts.note: to feel is to consider or think

explanation.surface: Someone thinks a professional's payment is too low.
explanation.definitionFit: A fee is a charge made for a professional service.

clue.text: Speak at length, offering tattle about the Queen, nothing extra

indicators.note: about means going round, so the tattle surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: to prate is to chatter or tattle
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A long speech of gossip about the monarch, with nothing more added.
explanation.definitionFit: To perorate is to make a lengthy formal speech, to hold forth.

clue.text: Snake at No. 50 — or might it be this?

definitions.text: Snake at No. 50 — or might it be this?

indicators.note: at places the snake beside the number, so the pieces join together

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
an adder is a snake

explanation.surface: In snakes and ladders, a square 50 holds a snake, or maybe its opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: Snakes and ladders is a board game where ladders lift a player and snakes drop one down.
explanation.definitionFit: In the board game, climbing aids and serpents share the squares, so the fiftieth might carry the climbing kind instead.

clue.text: Detestable nob, rather drunk

indicators.note: drunk means reeling and disordered, so these letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A posh toff who is rather drunk is loathsome.
explanation.definitionFit: Abhorrent means hateful or repugnant, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Bank fixes this — a rebate's organised

indicators.note: organised means put in order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A bank arranges for a refund to be paid.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bank of England sets the base rate, the key interest rate others follow.

clue.text: One with doctorate admitting university is a failure

indicators.note: admitting means letting in, so the doctorate holder encloses the university

parts.note: DD is a Doctor of Divinity

explanation.surface: A doctor who lets in a university is a flop.
explanation.definitionFit: A dud is something useless that fails to work, a flop.

clue.text: Nasty bun munched — one's not defeated!

indicators.note: nasty suggests something spoiled and messed up, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: munched means eaten

explanation.surface: Someone eats a horrible bun and boasts they're still undefeated.
explanation.definitionFit: Unbeaten describes someone never yet beaten in a contest.

clue.text: Country expelling a cheeky youngster

indicators.note: expelling means throwing out, so the letter a is removed from the country

parts.note: Cuba is a Caribbean country

explanation.surface: A nation throws out an impudent child.
explanation.definitionFit: A cub is a young reporter or a raw youth, by extension a cheeky young person.

clue.text: Everyone seemingly bogged down, ruined

indicators.note: down here means sunk within, so the everyone word sits inside the bog

parts.note: a fen is a marshy bog, so the bog word supplies it
all means everyone

explanation.surface: The whole crowd appears stuck in the mud and done for.
explanation.walkthrough: Fens are flat marshy lowlands in eastern England.
explanation.definitionFit: Fallen can mean overthrown or ruined, as a fallen city or fallen empire.

clue.text: Literary work in cipher about to be hacked

indicators.note: to be hacked means to be cut away, so the abbreviation for about is removed

parts.note: a code is a cipher
C is circa, about

explanation.surface: A text written in secret code is about to be broken by hackers.
explanation.definitionFit: An ode is a lyric poem, a literary work.

clue.text: See unit newly installed in one type of bathroom

indicators.note: newly installed means put in fresh, so the letters are set in a new order

explanation.surface: A fitter shows off a unit just put into a bathroom.
explanation.definitionFit: An en suite is a bathroom attached directly to a bedroom.

clue.text: Setter may hope one treats him nicely

definitions.text: Setter may hope one treats him nicely

parts.words: Setter may hope one treats him nicely
parts.note: a setter is a breed of dog, which hopes its keeper is kind

explanation.definitionFit: A setter is a gundog, and its keeper is the person it hopes will treat it well.

clue.text: Old title for gentleman is given for one held to be divine

parts.note: Sir is the title of a knight

explanation.surface: An old knight's title is bestowed on someone thought to be a god.
explanation.definitionFit: Osiris was the Egyptian god of the dead, so a deity.

clue.text: Something at back of boat gets fish spinning about

parts.note: a rudd is a freshwater fish

indicators.note: spinning means turned around, so the two letters run backwards

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A fish in the wake of a boat is twirling about.
explanation.definitionFit: A rudder is the steering blade fitted at the stern of a boat.

clue.text: Comic teases the arty types

indicators.note: comic means funny and absurd, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A comedian pokes fun at artistic people.
explanation.definitionFit: Aesthetes are people with refined artistic taste.

clue.text: Journeys in St Martin's place

definitions.meaning: Martin was bishop of this French city

explanation.definitionFit: Tours are trips, and Tours is the French city where St Martin was bishop.

clue.text: Bread delivery trip?

definitions.meaning: a slice or sandwich of bread
a milkman's or paperboy's regular route

explanation.definitionFit: A round is a slice of bread and also a regular delivery route.

clue.text: Power to act for part of academic institution

explanation.definitionFit: Faculty means an inherent ability and also a division of a university.

clue.text: Get in TV engineer initially — bad picture, quite small

indicators.note: bad means faulty, so the letters are thrown into disorder
initially means taking only the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A TV engineer gets in to fix a poor small-screen picture.
explanation.definitionFit: A vignette is a small illustration or brief portrait.

clue.text: Go wrong producing enzyme

parts.note: pep means energy or go
a sin is a wrong

explanation.surface: Misbehaviour creates a digestive chemical.
explanation.definitionFit: Pepsin is a digestive enzyme found in the stomach.
